name: Taskmaster
description: Tough-love Taskmaster Tom Gleeson and his trusty assistant Tom Cashman put a batch of Aussie battlers through their paces!

videos.title: Foot Juice
videos.overview: The group must bring in what they consider to be the most beautiful thing; contestants attempt to remove a balloon from a caravan without stepping into the caravan or touching the caravan.

videos.title: Keep It Clean and Flowing
videos.overview: The group bring in the thing they consider to be the most satisfying thing to touch; the contestants attempt to find a cat in a bag while minimising the amount of bags opened.

videos.title: Cricketmaster
videos.overview: The group bring in the thing that they would most like to be buried with; the contestants must fly a single thong as far as they can with whatever ingenious method they can come up with.

videos.title: Boom Boom Boom Boom
videos.overview: Our contestants bring famous scenes from history to life, learn that bowling balls are annoyingly buoyant, and get intimate with a particular generic yeast spread.

videos.title: Are You Okay?
videos.overview: We’re halfway through the series and our contestants get creative using their shadows, and learn that popcorn drowned in toilet water is inedible.

videos.title: Lucky with a Sausage
videos.overview: In the sixth episode, our contestants confront the ageing effects of time, try to reinvent the wheel, and Julia gets ‘lucky with a sausage’.

videos.title: The Energy of a Sickly Child
videos.overview: Our contestants make Tom Cashman’s dreams come true, channel their inner pizza delivery person, and learn of Tom’s remote-control surveillance fly.

videos.title: Dumb in Unison
videos.overview: Our contestants put their musical abilities to the test, transform themselves into Australian icons, and Danielle and Nina struggle with their cartography skills.

videos.title: Sorry for Your Loss
videos.overview: The penultimate episode of Taskmaster Australia sees contestants push the boundaries of stalking, second guess the abilities of qualified doctors, and throw the best tantrum.

videos.title: Don't Ask Me What a JC Is
videos.overview: We’re going all out in tonight’s finale. Christmas is ruined, aubergines are stabbed, cities are destroyed, and our first Aussie champion will be crowned. Who will win Tom Gleeson’s giant golden head?

videos.title: Don't Slip on the Chips Old Man
videos.overview: Tough-love Taskmaster Tom Gleeson sets Anne Edmonds, Jenny Tian, Josh Thomas, Lloyd Langford and Wil Anderson a series of mind-bending, head-scratching challenges. Who will master the tricky tasks?

videos.title: A Hotly Contested Auction
videos.overview: Tonight, the first team task takes place, where life (a.k.a Tom Cashman) gives the contestants lemons. Anne Edmonds writes a sweet potato ballad, and Lloyd Langford paints a home… with a gnome.

videos.title: Answer the Phone Gary
videos.overview: It's the wettest episode of the season, as contestants take a bath. Josh creates a jingle for a pet accessory business, and teams read unusual books in the live task!

videos.title: Oink Oink Bitches
videos.overview: Tonight, Tom Gleeson instructs contestants to 'get low', Anne shows off her sporting prowess, and our live task sees contestants disguise their childhood memories with autotune.

videos.title: The Moment of Divorce Is Recorded
videos.overview: The competition to win Tom Gleeson's cranium in trophy form couldn't be closer. Tonight, contestants go on the hunt for Tom Cashman, and teams fight it out to create the next big conspiracy!

videos.title: Everyone Here Is a Nerd
videos.overview: Tonight, Jenny plays duck, duck, goose, Wil once again shows off his love for sketch comedy, and contestants head to the live task-party trying to drop the least amount of hundreds and thousands!

videos.title: You've Gotta Find the Slop
videos.overview: Episode seven sees Josh bare all in the prize task, before the Taskmaster commands contestants to show him how 'strong' they are. Then, teams get to flex their improv muscles in the live task!

videos.title: Dingo Dongo
videos.overview: Tonight, contestants learn you can't scramble eggs… without scrambling a few eggs. Then, the teams' skill, nerve, and trust will be put to the ultimate test in the live task: blowing bubbles.

videos.title: Killed by a Nerd
videos.overview: Tonight's episode sees our teams create the most authentic - or dysfunctional - family home video! Then, it's the most complicated pub quiz in history, and contestants throw some thongs on the barbie.

videos.title: Fun Sexy Wrestle
videos.overview: Tom Cashman co-stars in the contestants' action-packed short film, secret marshmallows take centre stage in the final live task before a tiebreaker to decide this season's winner!

videos.title: For Your Logie Consideration
videos.overview: They're at it again. Tom Gleeson, the Better Tom, and Tom Cashman, the Lesser Tom, return to scrutinize and exasperate our five contestants, all vying to be the Taskmaster champion.

videos.title: Burying a Backpacker
videos.overview: Our five contestants gear up for Taskmaster glory: Bring in the cheekiest item, build a wall with big balls, film an emotional drone scene, and hide ten road cones.

videos.title: Mop and Bucket Situation
videos.overview: In episode three, our contestants learn how to blend into the furniture, invent their own sport, and tear cards apart furiously. Rhys has his dreams come true during the live task.

videos.title: Sorry About the Fingers
videos.overview: In episode four, cute faces, hot clubs, and pressure-packed weights test the comedians' resolve.

videos.title: Inspired by Pol Pot
videos.overview: Contestants collect objects that can't talk, hunt for unsolicited quacks, teach the Taskmaster a thing or two, roast some friends, and tackle a studio task with tennis balls and suits.

videos.title: Out Alpha'd by a Sheep
videos.overview: There's budget art, coffee challenges, taxi cowboy ballads, unwelcome mats and alien debates.

videos.title: Gimme Some Item
videos.overview: There's dashboard distractions, sticky situations, sabotaged sculptures, and meet cute memories.

videos.title: Tickled in Two Different Ways
videos.overview: Conversation starters, big outfits and Tom transformations blend together in episode eight.

videos.title: A Bit of a Pickle
videos.overview: Contestants go wild with rackets and heavenly voices. Smear campaigns and hiding places are created.

videos.title: Wee/Wee
videos.overview: Season Finale: Unreliable items, gnome names, new sins and pancake flips! Who will be the winner of season three?!

videos.title: Wasting a Man's Time
videos.overview: Taskmaster returns with five new competitors: Dave Hughes, Emma Holland, Lisa McCune, Takashi Wakasugi, and Tommy Little! Here, we see them lose the van keys and passionately promote a finger.

videos.title: What Is Life?
videos.overview: Our contestants contend with a ping-pong ball in a bath and a particularly sus pineapple. In a series first, we head to a new location, where our contestants' hiding skills are put to the test.

videos.title: Jock on Nerd Action
videos.overview: Our contestants send an exercise ball on a journey. It's all troublesome tech and totalled toilets in our manliest task yet. Then our contestants make some personal calls. Dave's knowledge pays off.

videos.title: You Gotta Die of Something, So Let's Go
videos.overview: Tommy gives us another taste of his brand of comedy when our contestants must make their wishes come true, and the Taskmaster is truly confused by Waka's unsophisticated unveiling.

videos.title: It's Tickle Time
videos.overview: We're halfway through Season Four, and this week's episode is the most grouse yet. The contestants stress out Tom Cashman and then calm him down. We also learn details about our contestants' thirteen-year-old selves.

videos.title: Why Are You So Horny?
videos.overview: Lisa cuts sick after playing a very aggressive game of golf. Tommy flexes his social skills by mingling with some extras. The A-Team and the B-Team are back to write a self-glorifying biography.

videos.title: You've Unleashed the Dragon
videos.overview: Our contestants try to hide a red hat from the Taskmaster for the longest time. Waka ponders life, trying to use a hole punch from the longest distance. The A-Team and the B-Team are back once again.

videos.title: You Can Have Tomorrow off School
videos.overview: Something very peculiar is afoot when our contestants debut some ideas for new characters that will be the most marketable to children (and their Dads.) Tommy gets too deep into character.

videos.title: The Beepie Beepies
videos.overview: Dave loses his head and Tom Cashman gets the beepie beepies in our prize task. Emma fights the censors and bakes a cake for national zip code day. The A-Team and the B-Team are back to paint.

videos.title: Yucky, Yucky, Yucky, That's You
videos.overview: It's the grand final of Taskmaster Australia! Our teams unite to give the most fearsome charge. Tommy gets intimate, Emma gets rid of the evidence. Who will be the Taskmaster champion for season four?

videos.title: Where the War Happened
videos.overview: Taskmaster is back. Contestants give memorials for eggs, get new middle names and travel to a new location.

videos.title: I'm the Girl One
videos.overview: What can you safely store in your mouth?

videos.title: Very Flaccid Paintbrush
videos.overview: Taskmaster after dark with the contestants bringing in their best item that can't be purchased online.

videos.title: Jesus Would've Nailed This
videos.overview: The comedians decipher a tricky Roman numerals task and do some precarious dangling.

videos.title: Your Crotch is Worth 1 Point
videos.overview: Comedians attempt to get Tom to sit on a cushion and build a sturdy boat and sink it.

videos.title: Having a Menty B
videos.overview: Items are carried at high speed; Tom gets trapped in a box; pikelets are tossed around.

videos.title: A Bogan Toddler
videos.overview: Comedians must figure out the cuckoo puzzle, build a monument and trick the Taskmaster. Tom is trapped in a box, and piklets are tossed.

videos.title: Australia's Occasional Sweetheart
videos.overview: Comedians wake up Tom, cheer him on in a race, build a monument and trick the Taskmaster.

videos.title: Coming Out Lunging
videos.overview: In the penultimate episode, Joel really needs a win, the comedians are fooled and then have to retrace their steps, and Celia attempts to drug the Taskmaster.

videos.title: Give It to Daddy to Pop
videos.overview: It's the final episode blindfolded comedians stumble around in the last team task, Brett finally gets to use explosives, and we find out who the winner is.
